Karnataka Police Limit Media Access to Senior Officers

Karnataka police have issued an order restricting media interactions to designated senior officers. The directive also prohibits officers from posting official police matters on social media without prior authorization. Police stated these measures are intended to prevent disclosures that could compromise ongoing investigations.
